item.title: Rallying Cry – July 6, 2026
item.description: Norway stuns Brazil in the World Cup, a son bravely rescues his father from Venezuela’s earthquake rubble, and Turkiye prepares to host its first NATO summit in decades—plus, the Pope champions migrant rights in a powerful visit to Lampedusa!
